script.text: Yubel sought a final confrontation against Jaden.
Yubel, you wanna duel? If it's a fight you're lookin' for, I'm up for it!
Since you're up for a challenge, let's have this duel. Follow me if you dare.
Come on, pal. You really have to ask?
Well then, here. I'm guessing you won't let me come with you, so take my deck and give that Yubel a little piece of my mind. Can you do that?
Thanks, Jesse. Now get some rest and regain your strength.
You sure you should go? It's probably some kind of trap. There could be a hundred fiends waiting for you! Or some scary monster!
Well, in that case, I don’t wanna miss out.
As Jaden ascended to oblivion to duel Yubel, he was met with a barrage of memories from his youth and learned that Yubel was his childhood friend.
Yubel explained how she became the way she was – she absorbed the Light of Destruction's rays and was transformed.
Despite the destruction it would cause, Yubel wished to unite all worlds into one so that she and Jaden could be together forever.
Jaden knew the only way to save all the worlds was to absorb Yubel into his own body.
Shall we settle this once and for all, Jaden? Are you ready to face me head-on?
As long as you’re not using Jesse as cover, I’m comin’ at you with everything I got!
I wouldn’t want it any other way. Now give me your best shot!
Oh I will, Yubel. Let's do this!
